item.title: Eight hospitalized after turbulence diverts flight to Miami
item.description: Officials say an Avianca flight from Colombia to New York was diverted to Miami after turbulence injured passengers.

item.title: Fugitive arrested after living double life as popular chef
item.description: U.S. Marshals say a man known as Troy Williams, a chef at Miss B's Coconut Club in San Diego, is actually 50-year-old Brian Anthony Williams.

item.title: Obama raises over $13 million for Democrats
item.description: Former President Barack Obama is reviving his signature campaign slogan in a new series of digital ads for Democrats.

item.title: Hurricane Isaias strengthens, aims for northern Gulf Coast
item.description: Hurricane Isaias, the first Atlantic hurricane of 2026, is strengthening as it targets the Gulf Coast from Mississippi to Florida.
